name: Resolver Budget Compliance Audit
description: Audits resolver executions to detect budget non-compliance where actual costs exceed declared budgets by ≥2x. Generates compliance reports and proposes budget corrections for impulses.

tasks.name: Fetch Recent Execution Traces
tasks.description: Retrieve execution traces from the past 7 days to analyze resolver costs.

input.query: SELECT resolver_id, vessel_id, impulse_id, declared_budget_usd, cost_usd, tokens_used, latency_ms, created_at FROM impulse_resolutions WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'

tasks.name: Analyze Budget Overruns
tasks.description: Process execution traces to identify instances where actual cost exceeded declared budget by ≥2x.

input.prompt: Analyze the provided execution traces. For each resolver, calculate the overrun_ratio = cost_usd / declared_budget_usd. Identify all rows where overrun_ratio >= 2.0. Group by resolver_id and vessel_id. Compute average overrun_ratio per resolver. Return JSON with fields: resolver_id, vessel_id, overrun_ratio, count_violations, avg_cost_usd, avg_declared_budget_usd, impulse_ids.

tasks.name: Generate Budget Compliance Report
tasks.description: Create a structured compliance report summarizing budget violations per resolver.

input.prompt: Based on the budget overrun analysis, generate a comprehensive compliance report. Include: (1) Executive summary of total violations and average overrun ratio, (2) Per-resolver breakdown with overrun_ratio, violation_count, and severity classification (low/medium/high based on overrun_ratio), (3) List of most problematic impulse IDs, (4) Timestamp of report generation. Return as structured JSON.

tasks.name: Compute Resolver Compliance Scorecard
tasks.description: Generate a per-resolver compliance scorecard with metrics and recommendations.

input.prompt: From the compliance report, create a resolver compliance scorecard. For each resolver with violations, calculate: (1) compliance_score = 100 * (1 - min(overrun_ratio - 1.0, 1.0)) [capped at 0-100], (2) risk_level based on overrun_ratio and violation_count, (3) recommended_action (audit/correction/throttle). Include timestamp and resolver metadata. Return as JSON array.

tasks.name: Propose Impulse Budget Corrections
tasks.description: Generate correction proposals to update impulse budget metadata based on realized costs.

input.prompt: For each impulse_id with overrun_ratio >= 2.0, propose a budget correction. Calculate: (1) new_declared_budget = avg_cost_usd * 1.15 (15% safety margin), (2) correction_rationale = 'Realized cost exceeded declared budget by {overrun_ratio}x', (3) confidence_score based on sample size. Return JSON array with fields: impulse_id, old_budget_usd, new_budget_usd, overrun_ratio, sample_count, confidence_score, effective_date.

tasks.name: Write Compliance Report to File
tasks.description: Persist the compliance report to the file system for audit trail.

tasks.name: Write Resolver Scorecard to File
tasks.description: Persist the resolver compliance scorecard for operational review.

tasks.name: Write Budget Corrections to File
tasks.description: Persist proposed budget corrections for implementation review.

successCriteria: budgetComplianceReport is generated and contains at least one resolver with overrun_ratio >= 2.0
resolverComplianceScorecard includes compliance_score and risk_level for each flagged resolver
impulseBudgetCorrection proposals include new_budget_usd adjusted upward from realized costs
All three output shapes are populated and persisted to audit logs
